21	      <g fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
22	        <g stroke-width="7">
23	          <path d="M 84 64 q -6 0 -6 6 l 0 11 q 0 6 -6 6 q 6 0 6 6 l 0 11 q 0 6 6 6" />
24	          <path d="M 100 64 q 6 0 6 6 l 0 11 q 0 6 6 6 q -6 0 -6 6 l 0 11 q 0 6 -6 6" />
25	        </g>
26	        <g stroke-width="5">
27	          <path d="M 92 80 L 92 94" />
28	          <path d="M 86 83.5 L 98 90.5" />
29	          <path d="M 86 90.5 L 98 83.5" />
30	        </g>
31	      </g>
32	    </mask>
33	    <rect x="8" y="8" width="112" height="112" rx="24" fill="${fill}" mask="url(#cut)" />
34	  </svg>`;
35	
36	const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${WIDTH}" height="${HEIGHT}" viewBox="0 0 ${WIDTH} ${HEIGHT}">
37	  <defs>
38	    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
39	      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0c1a1a" />
40	      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#04100f" />
41	    </linearGradient>
42	  </defs>
43	
44	  <rect width="${WIDTH}" height="${HEIGHT}" fill="url(#bg)" />

46	  <!-- Oversized watermark mark bleeding off the right edge. -->

48	
49	  <!-- Teal top accent rule. -->
50	  <rect x="0" y="0" width="${WIDTH}" height="10" fill="${TEAL}" />
51	
52	  <!-- Logo tile + wordmark. -->
53	  ${mark(96, 150, 150, TEAL)}
54	  <text x="270" y="272" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="132" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff" letter-spacing="-4">cssdoc</text>

56	  <!-- Tagline. -->

## The problem
`docs/public/favicon.png` was an orphan: referenced in the config's `<link rel="icon">`, present on your disk (dropped in manually on July 2), but never committed and produced by no build step. It's caught by the `docs/public/*` gitignore rule, so a fresh CI checkout has no favicon and the deployed icon 404s.

## The fix
Generate it at build time, the same way as the nav logos and og.png. The favicon is the Instructure `icon-three-dot` mark — I confirmed it matches `@pantoken/plugin-logos`' `full-color-bg` variant exactly (navy `#0f1923` tile, blue/green/red dots, white bar). I extended [`docs/scripts/logo.ts`](docs/scripts/logo.ts) to rasterize that SVG to a 512×512 PNG via resvg (already a dep from the og.png work) and write `favicon.png`. `logo.ts` runs first in `docs:assets`, so every build and CI checkout now produces it, and it stays git-ignored like the rest of `public/`.

Verified: the generated favicon matches the original pixel-for-pixel (and is smaller — 6.5 KB vs 11.9 KB), and both resvg asset scripts run cleanly back-to-back.

- **Your custom-domain commit** (`84c84d1`) moved the site to `pantoken.iywahl.com` with `base` `/`. ## What I changed

You chose to bundle a font, so the card now renders in **Atkinson Hyperlegible Next** — the exact face the docs site uses (`--vp-font-family-base`), for visual consistency.

- **Vendored the font as TTF** — [`docs/assets/fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegibleNext/`](docs/assets/fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegibleNext/), four weights (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold), ~250 KB total. resvg reads TTF/OTF but not WOFF2, so I converted them from the WOFF2 files the repo already vendors under `formats/components/assets/fonts` — same font, same version, no separate download.
- **Loaded them explicitly** in [`gen-og.ts`](docs/scripts/gen-og.ts): `loadSystemFonts: false`, `fontFiles`, `defaultFontFamily`. With system fonts off, a stray Ubuntu substitute can't sneak in — the render is deterministic across your Mac and CI.
- All card text now uses the exact family name `Atkinson Hyperlegible Next` (the SVG previously asked for `'Atkinson Hyperlegible'`, which wouldn't match the loaded face and would have rendered blank under `loadSystemFonts: false`).

## Why this fixes CI
I proved it locally the way CI will run it: `loadSystemFonts: false` with only the bundled TTFs produces correct Atkinson glyphs (a control render with no fonts came out blank, confirming nothing leaks from my system). CI runs the same resvg against the same committed TTFs, so it renders identically — no more generic serif/sans.

## Notes
- **Commit together**: the two uncommitted changes — `gen-og.ts` and `docs/assets/fonts/**` — are a pair. `gen-og.ts` references those TTF paths, so committing one without the other breaks the build. (I haven't committed anything.)
- **Weights**: the card currently uses 400/500/700; I bundled 600 (SemiBold) too so the standard weight ramp is there if you tweak the design. Drop it if you want a leaner bundle.
- **Licensing follow-up**: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is SIL OFL 1.1. The repo currently ships these fonts (the WOFF2 set) without an `OFL.txt`; adding the license text alongside the vendored fonts would be the correct thing to do, but I left existing practice as-is rather than change it unprompted.
